note: Provenance for every committed image. evidence_type says what kind of claim the figure can support; a figure whose inputs are not in the repository is marked so explicitly rather than given a command that cannot run.

figures.boundary: Synthetic scene from make_scene(size=256, seed=1); demonstrates the extractor's behaviour, not performance on real imagery.
figures.reproducibility: Deterministic given the seed. Numeric output (scene fingerprint and candidate geometry) is pinned in results/method_demo_synthetic.numeric.json and gated by analysis/tests/test_demo_reproducibility.py. Do NOT gate on PNG bytes: font rasterisation differs between freetype builds, so the text bands change while every data pixel is identical -- see results/method_demo_synthetic.env.json.

inputs: a manual Google Earth Engine raster export (not in this repository)
figures.boundary: Legacy full-field-rendering placeholder displayed by the top-level README. Not a claimed result.
figures.blocking_dependency: dated reference-imagery provenance frozen for all three development sites and negative-01 in config/sites.geojson, then the pre-registered Phase-1 gate run per results/README.md

figures.boundary: Explanatory diagram referenced from README.md; no generator and no underlying measurement.

figure_comparison_policy.reason: For method-demo-synthetic, a committed-vs-fresh PNG diff shows 1.59% of pixels differing, all of it glyph rasterisation in the title and footer bands; every pixel inside both axes is identical. Comparing bytes would report drift that does not exist, and a real change in the scene or the extracted geometry would be lost in that noise.
figure_comparison_policy.verified_stable_across: numpy 2.1.3 / scipy 1.14.1 and numpy 2.4.6 / scipy 1.17.1 -- same scene sha256, same six candidate endpoints, byte-identical PNG
